judgement call: event Saturday 1 November 1997, before Cloud City's most likely street date (Wednesday 5 November 1997); a Swedish event would also have had the new English set later than US stores. No source puts Cloud City in stores before 5 November, so the exact day is not proven but was most likely Wednesday 5 November 1997. Constructed per page type.

judgement call from the decklists: both decks Andy McClure posted on 29 October 2000 as his 3–0 Birmingham winners use cards first printed in the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck product (released 25 October 2000): Dark has Mighty Jabba, Power Of The Hutt, Hutt Influence, My Kind Of Scum, Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages, Tatooine: Desert Heart (7 JPSD cards); Light has Palace Raider, Lando With Vibro-Ax, Agents In The Court, Underworld Contacts, Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert) (6 JPSD cards). That fits McClure's 'yesterday' (28 October 2000), not Decipher's 7–8 October calendar date (which was also DecipherCon 2000 weekend, 5–8 October). The two deck pages are tagged Premiere - Death Star II and should be retagged.
discrepancy: Decipher's Grand Slam calendar dates the event 7–8 October 2000; Andy McClure's DeckTech post of 29 October 2000 says he won it 'yesterday' (28 October 2000), and his decks contain Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck cards released 25 October 2000.
